cases.description: A tulpa: agentId normalizes to the key principal.
The ink: alias of the same key normalizes to the same principal.
A literal key: agentId is escaped to raw:key:, never confused with the canonical key principal.
A did:web identity is carried through unchanged.

A non-ASCII identifier whose UTF-16 length is within the 512 cap (its UTF-8 byte length is not) is accepted and passed through, so an implementation that measures length in bytes instead of UTF-16 code units would diverge here.
